title: Schur partition identity for all n via Glaisher bijection (formalize-only)
recommendation: BENCH only (budget risk). Continuation of OPE-440/445/447 Glaisher ladder toward the full forall-n identity: number of partitions of n into distinct parts congruent to 1 or 2 mod 3 equals the number of partitions of n into parts congruent to +/-1 mod 6. The finite-certificate scope is CLOSED (OPE-424/426, PR #27) and the ladder infra exists on unmerged branches ope/440/445/447 — eligible ONLY because lifting finite certs to the universal statement via an explicit Glaisher-style bijection is a genuinely new proof layer (bijection construction + nodup/parts preservation), not a re-warm. Highest infra value in the pool: Mathlib v4.10.0 has Nat.Partition vocabulary but no Euler/Glaisher bijection and no partition generating-function infrastructure.
